'''D'nisenz''' was a [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] player as of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. In 22 BBY he participated in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies Region]] [[Colonies region Dejarik tournament|dejarik championship]], and witnessed a brawl between two other players, [[Ohh Bronna]] and [[Corwin Kaezeb]]. D'nisenz continued his quarterfinals match with [[Garem Will]] as the fight escalated, not noticing the mayhem until their board flickered off. Due to a lack of established protocol for such occurrences, D'nisenz was declared Colonies Region dejarik champion.
